note: The fixture's commit history, replayed by runner/fixture_app.py with fixed author, committer and dates so the SHAs are identical on every build. A step's `files` are copied from tree/ in their FINAL form; a step's `patch` rewrites text in files already present (each `before` must occur exactly once). When a file is first added, the builder applies every later non-reverted patch to it in reverse (after -> before), so the file enters history in its oldest form and the patches replay the real edits forward. A `revert` step reverts the previous commit; that commit's patch is marked `reverted` so it is excluded from the reverse pass.
